chunks: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, is not a tyrant to His servants, nor does He betray in the covenant, nor break His promise, nor forget the matter after He has commanded it, nor diminish anything from the reward, nor waste the deed of any of them.

key_terms.ظَلَّامٍ: tyrant or one who deals unjustly

ai.seo_question: What are the key attributes of Allah regarding justice and keeping promises according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights these divine attributes to reinforce the Shia doctrine of divine justice (*Adl*), assuring believers that Allah’s covenant is immutable and His recompense is precise. This serves as a theological anchor for the concept of *Tawqit* (timing of reward), emphasizing that no deed, however small, is overlooked by the Faithful Watcher.
